chapters.title: The first census
chapters.summary: At Sinai, God tells Moses to count Israel's men able to serve in the army, tribe by tribe. The Levites are not counted, because they care for the tabernacle.

chapters.title: The camp arranged
chapters.summary: Each tribe has its place around the tabernacle under its own banner, three tribes on each side, with the tabernacle at the center.

chapters.title: The Levites
chapters.summary: The Levites are set apart to serve Aaron's priestly family, taken by God in place of Israel's firstborn. Their clans and duties are recorded.

chapters.title: Duties of the Levite clans
chapters.summary: The Kohathites, Gershonites and Merarites are each given tasks for carrying the tabernacle and its holy objects when Israel moves.

chapters.title: Purity in the camp
chapters.summary: The unclean are placed outside the camp, wrongs must be confessed and repaid, and a ritual is given for a husband who suspects his wife of unfaithfulness.

chapters.title: The Nazirite and the blessing
chapters.summary: Laws for those who take a Nazirite vow of special devotion. God gives Aaron the priestly blessing: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee.

chapters.title: Gifts of the leaders
chapters.summary: Over twelve days, the leaders of the twelve tribes each bring identical offerings for the dedication of the altar. Then Moses hears God speaking from above the mercy seat.

chapters.title: The lamps and the Levites
chapters.summary: Aaron sets up the lamps of the lampstand. The Levites are purified and presented as an offering, given to serve on Israel's behalf.

chapters.title: Passover and the cloud
chapters.summary: Israel keeps the second Passover, with provision for those who were unclean. The cloud over the tabernacle tells them when to move and when to stay.

chapters.title: Leaving Sinai
chapters.summary: Silver trumpets are made for calling the people. Israel sets out from Sinai in order, with the ark going before them.

chapters.title: Complaints and quail
chapters.summary: The people complain about manna and long for Egypt's food. Moses feels the burden is too heavy, so God shares His Spirit with seventy elders and sends quail, with a plague.

chapters.title: Miriam and Aaron oppose Moses
chapters.summary: Miriam and Aaron criticize Moses. God defends him as the humblest of men and His faithful servant, and Miriam is struck with a skin disease for seven days.

chapters.title: The twelve spies
chapters.summary: Twelve spies explore Canaan and find it flowing with milk and honey. Ten say its people are too strong. Only Caleb urges, "Let us go up at once."

chapters.title: Israel refuses the land
chapters.summary: The people weep and want to return to Egypt. Joshua and Caleb plead with them. God forgives at Moses' plea, but that generation will wander forty years.

chapters.title: Offerings and the tassels
chapters.summary: Laws for offerings once Israel is in the land, for unintentional and defiant sins, and the blue tassels to remind them of God's commands.

chapters.title: Korah's rebellion
chapters.summary: Korah, Dathan and Abiram lead a revolt against Moses and Aaron. The ground swallows the rebels, and Aaron stands between the living and the dead to stop a plague.

chapters.title: Aaron's staff buds
chapters.summary: To end the grumbling, God makes Aaron's staff sprout, blossom and bear almonds overnight, confirming His choice of Aaron's family as priests.

chapters.title: Duties of priests and Levites
chapters.summary: The priests and Levites bear responsibility for the sanctuary. They receive no land, because the Lord is their inheritance, and the tithes support them.

chapters.title: The red heifer
chapters.summary: The ashes of a red heifer are mixed with water to cleanse anyone who has touched a dead body.

chapters.title: Water from the rock
chapters.summary: Miriam dies. When the people have no water, Moses strikes the rock in anger instead of speaking to it, and God says he will not lead Israel into the land. Aaron dies on Mount Hor.

chapters.title: The bronze serpent
chapters.summary: When the people speak against God, venomous snakes bite them. Moses makes a bronze serpent on a pole, and whoever looks at it lives. Israel defeats Sihon and Og.

chapters.title: Balaam and his donkey
chapters.summary: King Balak of Moab hires the prophet Balaam to curse Israel. On the way, Balaam's donkey sees the angel of the Lord blocking the road and speaks.

chapters.title: Balaam's first blessings
chapters.summary: Twice Balaam tries to curse Israel and twice he can only bless them, because God is not a man that He should lie.

chapters.title: A star out of Jacob
chapters.summary: Balaam blesses Israel a third time and foresees a star rising out of Jacob and a scepter out of Israel. Balak sends him away in anger.

chapters.title: Sin at Peor
chapters.summary: Israelite men join Moabite women in worshiping Baal of Peor. A plague follows, and Phinehas acts with zeal to stop it.

chapters.title: The second census
chapters.summary: A new count is taken of the generation that will enter the land. Of those counted at Sinai, only Caleb and Joshua remain.

chapters.title: Zelophehad's daughters
chapters.summary: Five sisters ask to inherit their father's land, and God grants it. Joshua is commissioned to lead Israel after Moses.

chapters.title: Daily and feast offerings
chapters.summary: The regular offerings for each day, each Sabbath, each new month, Passover and the Feast of Weeks.

chapters.title: Offerings in the seventh month
chapters.summary: The offerings for the Feast of Trumpets, the Day of Atonement and the eight days of the Feast of Tabernacles.

chapters.title: Vows
chapters.summary: Vows made to the Lord must be kept. A father or husband may cancel a woman's vow on the day he hears it.

chapters.title: War with Midian
chapters.summary: Israel attacks Midian for leading them into idolatry at Peor. The spoils are divided and an offering is given to the Lord.

chapters.title: Tribes east of the Jordan
chapters.summary: Reuben and Gad ask to settle east of the Jordan. Moses agrees if they first help conquer Canaan: be sure your sin will find you out.

chapters.title: Israel's journey recorded
chapters.summary: A list of Israel's stopping places from Egypt to the plains of Moab, and a command to drive out the land's inhabitants and their idols.

chapters.title: The borders of the land
chapters.summary: God sets the boundaries of Canaan and names the leaders who will divide it among the tribes.

chapters.title: Cities of refuge
chapters.summary: Forty-eight towns are given to the Levites. Six are cities of refuge, where someone who kills another by accident may flee and be safe.

chapters.title: Inheritance kept in the tribe
chapters.summary: To keep land within each tribe, Zelophehad's daughters marry within their own tribe. The book closes on the plains of Moab by the Jordan.
